Full summary: Controller-reviewed Doc 3 + prepared-issues doc (bodies byte-identical to DOC B; cites verified); patched five maintainer-comment spots the Doc 3 reviewers had corrected but the issues lane never saw. Doc 2 lane still running.
Findings: The routing 'server creates at cwd vs hooks bind the ancestor' split is NOT durable: the server creates the spurious store at spawn (src/index.ts:52 before connect), and every hook fired afterwards finds it (env branch -d check activity-marker-hook.sh:72; walk checks $DIR/.twining at cwd first, :118) and binds it too — a coherent silent misroute, which is why the field's incident produced no signal. Plan §1.5 P2 wording ('hooks walk, server creates') is right but incomplete; Doc 3 §1.1/§2 and the issue comments now say coherent misroute.; Our own .twining/config.yml project_name: '.' was stamped at creation on 2026-02-18 (5cb0049) from a project root passed as '.', not by the plugin's later --project . launch — do not attribute it to the plugin.
